xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3191: Auto-merge rows strand forever: failed/blocked can never reach 'merged' and nothing reconciles them

plan.title: Auto-merge rows strand forever: reconcile failed/blocked rows against real merge state
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A pending_auto_merges row that reaches failed or blocked is stranded permanently: markMerged (src/lib/overdeck/merge-sync.ts:193) requires status='merging', which a failed/blocked row can never satisfy again, and no patrol reconciles rows against real merge state. The operator-facing problems list (GET /api/flywheel/auto-merge/problems) currently holds 15 residue rows across 13 issues, every one merged and closed-out weeks ago, making genuinely stuck merges indistinguishable from shipped work. pan merge cancel (fixed by PAN-3190) clears only ONE row per invocation, so duplicate rows (PAN-2297, PAN-1644) survive a cancel that reports success.
narratives.Proposal: Three changes plus docs. (1) Widen markMerged's precondition to status IN ('pending','blocked','failed','merging'). (2) New deacon reconciler reconcileAutoMergeRows in src/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-merge-reconcile.ts, wired into the deacon patrol after reconcileClosedPrReadyForMerge: group all actionable rows by issue (every row transitioned, not just the newest); tier 1 cancels pending/blocked/failed rows for closed-out issues via cancelPending(id,'auto-merge-reconciler') with no forge call; tier 2 calls findMergedArtifact for non-closed-out issues with blocked/failed rows and markMerged's every blocked/failed row on positive evidence; per-issue 10-min in-memory cooldown bounds forge cost; errors never leave a row cleared or escape the patrol. (3) DELETE /api/flywheel/auto-merge/:id returns remainingActionable via a new countActionableAutoMerges helper, and pan merge cancel prints the remaining count with re-run guidance; sync-sources/skills/pan-merge/SKILL.md updated in the same commit. (4) docs/FLYWHEEL.md gains a Reconciliation subsection. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-3191.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Reconciling rows stuck in 'merging' (separate mid-merge-crash failure class; follow-up issue if observed)
- Cancel-all semantics or a --all flag for pan merge cancel (single-row contract preserved; reporting only)
- On-read filtering or forge/git/tracker calls inside GET /api/flywheel/auto-merge/problems (it stays a pure DB read)
- One-off SQL or migration to clear the current 15 rows (the reconciler clears them on its first patrol after deploy)
- Changes to the auto-merge executor's retry/requeue/circuit-breaker policy

autoDecisions.summary: Reconcile on deacon patrol, not on HTTP read
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows 'on read or on patrol'. On-read puts forge/git calls in a request handler (latency and rate-limit failure modes in the operator UI path); the deacon reconciler pattern (reconcileClosedPrReadyForMerge, reconcileStuckMergingStates) is the established home for this exact drift class, and rows leaving via status transitions keeps the endpoint a pure DB read.

autoDecisions.summary: Closed-out issues' rows are cancelled without a forge call, not marked merged
autoDecisions.rationale: pan close is the mechanical DoD gate and only runs after the merge is verified, so re-proving the merge buys nothing; the issue explicitly authorizes age-out 'regardless of merge evidence'. cancelledBy='auto-merge-reconciler' records why the row left the queue, and the common residue sweep costs zero network calls.

autoDecisions.summary: Tier-2 evidence via findMergedArtifact, not observeForgeMergeState
autoDecisions.rationale: observeForgeMergeState does a git fetch plus merge-base per repo and patches merge-set rows — heavier than needed and mutates unrelated state. findMergedArtifact with the row's prUrl is one PR-state API call and is forge-agnostic (GitLab adapter implements it too).

autoDecisions.summary: pan merge cancel keeps single-row semantics; only remaining-row reporting is added
autoDecisions.rationale: The flywheel design note asked for a remaining-rows report, not cancel-all. Single-row cancel has deliberate race handling; a remainingActionable count in the DELETE response plus CLI guidance fixes the silent-residue UX (PAN-2297/PAN-1644 duplicates) without changing the operator contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Stuck 'merging' rows are out of scope
autoDecisions.rationale: A row orphaned in 'merging' by a mid-merge crash is a distinct failure class (it also wedges the unique active-issue index) and is not one of the issue's three expected behaviors; recorded as hazard H1 for a follow-up issue rather than expanding scope.

items.title: Widen markMerged precondition to accept pending/blocked/failed/merging

expected_outputs: all markMerged describe-block tests pass, including new pending/blocked/failed transition cases and merged/cancelled no-op cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/merge-sync.ts:196, change markMerged's UPDATE WHERE clause from `AND status = 'merging'` to `AND status IN ('pending','blocked','failed','merging')` (PRD WI-1). Extend the markMerged describe block in tests/unit/lib/overdeck/merge-sync-pending-auto-merges.test.ts using the existing seedPendingAutoMerge helper: seed failed, blocked, and pending rows and assert markMerged returns true and persists status='merged' with merged_at set; seed merged and cancelled rows and assert markMerged returns false and leaves the row unchanged. The existing 'marks merging → merged' test must pass unmodified.

items.title: Given a row seeded in failed, blocked, or pending status, when markMerged(id) runs, then it returns true and persists status='merged' with merged_at set
Given a row seeded in merged or cancelled status, when markMerged(id) runs, then it returns false and preserves the row unchanged
The pre-existing 'marks merging → merged and sets merged_at' test passes unmodified
Add reconcileAutoMergeRows deacon reconciler for failed/blocked/pending auto-merge rows

expected_outputs: all seven reconciler test cases pass, including the regression case (seeded failed row + merged PR leaves listProblemAutoMerges after one run) and the duplicate-row case (both rows of one issue transition in a single run)

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-merge-reconcile.ts shaped after reconcileStuckMergingStatesWithDeps (src/lib/cloister/deacon-stuck-merging.ts:92): export reconcileAutoMergeRowsWithDeps(deps) with the logic and reconcileAutoMergeRows() binding production deps (listProblemAutoMerges, listActiveAutoMerges, cancelPending, markMerged, readJournalStatusSync, resolveProjectFromIssueSync, getForgeAdapter, console.log). Per run (PRD Proposal §2): collect listProblemAutoMerges() rows plus pending-only rows from listActiveAutoMerges() (never touch 'merging'); group by issueId and process EVERY row of an issue; skip issues inside a module-local 10-minute cooldown Map<string,number> (pattern: closedPrReadyReconcileCooldowns, deacon-merge.ts:334). Tier 1: if readJournalStatusSync(issueId)?.durable.closedOut === true, cancelPending(id,'auto-merge-reconciler') every pending/blocked/failed row — no forge call. Tier 2 (non-closed-out issues with blocked/failed rows only): getForgeAdapter(row.forge).findMergedArtifact({ sourceBranch: 'feature/<issueId-lowercase>', artifactUrl: row.prUrl, cwd: resolveProjectFromIssueSync(issueId).path }); non-null ⇒ markMerged(id) for each blocked/failed row; null ⇒ leave rows and set cooldown; throw ⇒ leave rows, set cooldown, console.warn, continue. Return action strings; never throw past the patrol. Wire-up: re-export through src/lib/cloister/deacon-merge.ts next to line 21 (`export { reconcileAutoMergeRows } from './deacon-auto-merge-reconcile.js';`), add to the import list at src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts:38 and the re-export list at deacon.ts:142, and invoke it in the deacon patrol immediately after the reconcileClosedPrReadyForMerge() block (~line 2950) with the same actions.push/addLog('action', a, state.patrolCycle) pattern. Tests: new tests/unit/lib/cloister/deacon-auto-merge-reconcile.test.ts with setupOverdeckTestDb and injected deps covering PRD WI-2 cases 1-7 (regression AC, closed-out tier-1 short-circuit with findMergedArtifact NOT called, pending+closed-out cancel, duplicate rows both transition, unmerged PR leaves row + cooldown suppresses immediate re-check, forge throw leaves row and nothing escapes, 'merging' rows untouched). Do not add forge/git calls to the problems route — rows leave the list via status transitions only (NFR-1).

items.title: Given a seeded failed row whose findMergedArtifact returns a merged artifact, when reconcileAutoMergeRows runs, then it persists status='merged' and listProblemAutoMerges() no longer returns the row

Given seeded pending/blocked/failed rows whose issue journal has closedOut: true, when the reconciler runs, then it cancels every one with cancelled_by='auto-merge-reconciler' and never calls findMergedArtifact
Given two failed rows for the same issue and positive merge evidence, when the reconciler runs once, then it transitions BOTH rows to merged in that single run

Given a failed row whose findMergedArtifact returns null or throws, when the reconciler runs, then it preserves the row in the problems list, sets the per-issue cooldown (a second immediate run skips the forge call), and no exception escapes to the caller
The reconciler preserves every 'merging' row untouched, and the deacon.ts patrol block calls reconcileAutoMergeRows immediately after the reconcileClosedPrReadyForMerge block
pan merge cancel reports remaining actionable rows for the issue

expected_outputs: countActionableAutoMerges, deleteAutoMergePayload remainingActionable, and mergeCancelCommand output tests pass

narrative.Action: Keep single-row cancel semantics; surface duplicates (PRD Proposal §3). Add countActionableAutoMerges(issueId) to src/lib/overdeck/merge-sync.ts: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pending_auto_merges WHERE issue_id = ? AND status IN ('pending','merging','blocked','failed'). In deleteAutoMergePayload (src/dashboard/server/routes/flywheel.ts:381-389), after a successful cancel include remainingActionable: countActionableAutoMerges(issueId) in the 200 body, threaded through AutoMergeCancelDeps as an injectable countRemaining dep defaulting to countActionableAutoMerges. In mergeCancelCommand (src/cli/commands/merge.ts:35-38) parse the JSON body and, when remainingActionable > 0, print `Cancelled auto-merge for <ID> (<N> actionable row(s) remain — re-run 'pan merge cancel <id>' to clear the next one)`; otherwise keep the current message. Update sync-sources/skills/pan-merge/SKILL.md in the SAME commit (skills-convention rule): document that cancel clears one row per invocation, that an issue can hold duplicate rows, and what the remaining-rows output means. Tests: countActionableAutoMerges counts pending/merging/blocked/failed and excludes merged/cancelled (merge-sync-pending-auto-merges.test.ts); deleteAutoMergePayload 200 body carries remainingActionable from the injected dep (flywheel.test.ts); mergeCancelCommand with a fake fetchImpl returning remainingActionable: 2 prints the '2 actionable row(s) remain' guidance (merge.test.ts).

items.title: countActionableAutoMerges returns the count of pending/merging/blocked/failed rows for an issue and excludes merged/cancelled rows
Given a successful cancel with further actionable rows, DELETE /api/flywheel/auto-merge/:id responds 200 with a body containing remainingActionable equal to the injected count
Given a DELETE response with remainingActionable: 2, pan merge cancel prints guidance containing '2 actionable row(s) remain' and the re-run command; with 0 it prints the unchanged success message
sync-sources/skills/pan-merge/SKILL.md states the one-row-per-invocation semantics and the remaining-rows output, and npm run lint (lint-skills.sh) passes
Document auto-merge row reconciliation in docs/FLYWHEEL.md

expected_outputs: grep finds a Reconciliation subsection after the Scheduled auto-merge recovery section

narrative.Action: In docs/FLYWHEEL.md, immediately after the 'Scheduled auto-merge recovery' bullet list (section starts at line 159), add a terse (~8 line) '### Reconciliation' subsection per PRD Proposal §4: failed/blocked are not terminal-residue states — a deacon reconciler flips rows to merged when the forge shows the PR merged, cancels actionable rows whose issue is closed-out, throttles forge checks per issue, and pan merge cancel clears one row per invocation and reports how many actionable rows remain.

items.title: docs/FLYWHEEL.md contains a '### Reconciliation' subsection after 'Scheduled auto-merge recovery' stating that closed-out issues' rows are cancelled and merged-elsewhere rows flip to merged
